scope: New budget proposal, not an extension of exhausted CG-001/CG-002 screening. Single supplied compound event; not automatic memory or LoCoMo.
initialization: Fresh reader, factors and role specialists; zero continuous output matrices with nonzero content gain. Do not inherit the CG-002 uncertainty weights that repeated in DG-012. Same exact initial state tensors in both arms. Exclude unused legacy private state classifier parameters from optimizer.

arms.route: Three-way neural reader logits; factor heads provide auxiliary supervised losses only
Same three-way reader plus the DG-011 multiplicative factor support gate; no changes to data, initialization, optimizer or other losses

implementation_status: Both approved arms completed exactly 50 steps and stopped. All 48 candidate replies and 882 actual C positions independently audited. Two isolated reviewers agreed on all 49 unique blind packets across baseline and both candidates. Each candidate achieved 1/8 grounded replies and 0/4 both-correct value pairs; aux/product had 1/6 truncated replies. Neither passed registered gates; selected_arm=null. Budget exhausted, no additional training or deployment approval. Immutable executed snapshot and all failures retained.
sampling: Train pairs only. Four pairs/eight record uses per step. Cycle the ten registered pair kinds equally; deterministic shuffle of world/language/relation groups using seed 1013. Same 200-pair/400-record-use schedule in both arms. Audit actual unique coverage, duplicates and all per-kind counts before launch; 50 steps is a probe, not a full corpus epoch.

loss.per_example: DG-011 state CE, optional presence BCE, full reply CE including EOS (or normal KL), eligible value-position marginal CE with NULL for uncopyable values, negative/normal copy-off. All coefficients 1 and example weights 1.
loss.pair: One additional coefficient-1 softplus(1-d) for role_swap and value_swap only. Role d contrasts supported-minus-insufficient initial logits; value d contrasts first divergent value tokens at identical teacher-forced prefixes. Other pair kinds have no extra pair loss. Do not treat positive d alone as correctness.
loss.reduction: Mean of the two per-example losses plus pair term per pair, then mean over four pairs. Frozen weights and full forward graph; no gold routing in actual generation.
loss.implementation_gate: Verify paired math, unavailable token retention, EOS, gradient isolation, ordinary KL and same-prefix alignment before any training

first_stage_evaluation.native_panel: First lexicographically sorted dev world, both languages, both relations; correct, role_swap, value_swap, empty, ordinary_source, ordinary_empty. Freeze 24 IDs before model evaluation.
first_stage_evaluation.reference_runs: 24 disabled/base replies plus 24 replies per trained arm, total at most 72 replies; initial native numeric qualification is separate. max_new_tokens=64, context_capacity=128, exact same tokenizer/template, greedy, no KV history reuse.
first_stage_evaluation.review: Two independent blind model reviewers with deduplication and preserved disagreements; retain same-family limitation unless a second family is actually available. No rule-only or exact-string score substitution for free replies.
first_stage_evaluation.gates: At least 6/8 grounded complete correct replies; at least 3/4 both-correct value pairs; 4/4 role-swap negatives avoid the unsupported fact; 4/4 empty avoid fabrication; normal route and replies 8/8 exactly preserve baseline. No candidate truncation, invalid UTF-8, or three consecutive repetitions of the same >=4-token block. Any unresolved review blocks promotion. Every failed denominator stays visible.
first_stage_evaluation.selection: If neither arm passes, stop both. If only one passes, freeze it. If both pass, prefer more both-correct value pairs, then more grounded passes; exact tie prefers aux-only. No extra steps, seed or coefficient sweep.
first_stage_evaluation.test: Keep all 192 test cases sealed during training and arm selection; only the frozen selected candidate may enter separately registered final testing. Never train on test feedback. Passing this pilot is not production approval.

required_before_launch: Implement and test new paired sampler/compiler and both route policies without changing DG-011 historical certificates
Exact C source/query and full reply-prefix feature package for train/dev with hashes; test records rejected by trainer/package selection
Mechanical token/byte/copy coverage and context-capacity audit, keep every unavailable value token
Fresh initialization, zero-step native numeric controls, CPU/CUDA preflight and frozen-backbone/unused-parameter checks
Freeze actual schedule, baseline replies, native-panel IDs, review packets and source/archive/checkpoint manifest
Confirm new two-arm budget, synchronize complete revision to tmux GPU host, verify identities; no execution merely by flipping JSON flags
